 by Perciculum Last Updated: October 31, 2026 Follow Get Link Welcome to Azeroth! With World of Warcraft: Forever launching on November 4, we’re excited to open the new WoW Forever branch on Maxroll. We’ve been putting together guides and tools to help you choose a class, work on your build, and find useful information as you explore the game. Here’s what you can find on the branch.
 Class Guides
 Our World of Warcraft: Forever experts have put together class and specialization build guides for all nine classes. They cover talents, rotations, and gearing, along with information for leveling, dungeons, and raids. Whether you’re figuring out how to build your character or looking for advice before heading into group content, you can use these guides to help plan your next steps.

 Tier Lists
 If you’re still deciding which class to play, our class tier lists can help you compare your options. We look at the top picks for leveling and PvE, so you can see how classes perform across different parts of the game. Once you have a class in mind, you can head to its detailed guides to learn more about its builds.
 Check out our Tier Lists:

 Planner and Community Builds
 The WoW: Forever Planner lets you put together your own build and share it with the community. You can also browse builds made by other players, see how they’ve set up their characters, and use their ideas as a starting point for your own build.
 How to Use the Planner
 If you haven’t used the planner before, our step-by-step guide walks you through its features and shows you how to create a build.
 Class selection
 This menu controls your profiles. Toggle between Edit and View mode.
 Click My profiles to see the profile manager.
 Create a new profile.
 Save build. Name your build.
 Set your build to public to share it with the community.
 Save the profile and notify anyone who has followed your build.
 Edit your build. Write an introduction.
 Add variants. 
 Distribute talent points and use the Notes section below to add explanations.
 Table of Contents. You can pin it to keep it visible when you scroll down.
 Add additional information about your build . Rotation.
 Gear & Stats.
 Important Class Unlocks.
 Campfire.
 Races
 FAQ.
 Summary.
 Changelog.
 Additional Tips Use ‘@’ to add items and spells to make use of our tooltip system.
 Pay attention to the default text in each Note component, since some of them support special blocks, such as /rotation .
 Profiles. Here you can: Rename your current profile, or create a new one.
 Add builds to profiles to keep them organized.
 See and sort your current builds. Available actions include renaming, duplicating, and deleting them.
 WoW Forever News
 Our WoW Forever news section is where you can catch up on announcements and updates about the game. We’ll keep adding coverage as new information becomes available, so check back to see what’s happening and what’s coming next.
 Here are some recent news highlights: 
 News WoW: Forever Roadmap - New Zones, Raids, Dungeons, and More
 World of Warcraft: Forever launches on November 4, 2026, and Blizzard has outlined a much wider journey than the content arriving on day one. The plans include new regions and quests across original Azeroth, new dungeons and raids, updates to classes and player systems, and more content to come...

 World of Warcraft: Forever’s Legacy System adds account-wide progression tied to activities across the game. Players earn Legacy Points through challenges involving classes, professions, PvP, exploration, dungeons, and raids. Those points can then be spent on perks for individual characters....
